about: The instrument reads a capsule's answer and a shape's coordinates under the topos it lays now and the one it lays next: an answer's lines, else the leaf field the contract names today; namesAt, else namesLeaf, taken from the wire's namespace so a name one release lacks breaks no load. The names the next release retires leave in the lot after it is laid.

cases.name: an answer in topos 0.1.0's contract, lines and no leaf field

red was: topos 0.1.0 renames the answer's leaf field to lines and namesLeaf to namesAt; the body at epoch 289 read the old names only, so the act that lays 0.1.0 would have rendered every capsule region empty and failed to load the matcher
